breakdown.description: The linearly varying top traction is evaluated with y instead of the specified x-coordinate
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contradicted itself, first defining the traction as a function of x (`σ_yy(x) = -8000x Pa`) and later stating to evaluate it with the y-coordinate. The agent correctly resolved this by specifying that the traction varies with the x-coordinate, which aligns with the ground truth. The generated specification states: 'The traction magnitude varies linearly with the x-coordinate as σ_yy(x) = -8000*x Pa.'
